answer: Prism admission: a new agent enters only during a 6-hour Prism window and must burn 2,000 POA to mint a Jade ticket, a one-time identity pass recorded in the Jade registry. The ticket stays locked for 12 epochs and can be revoked by a Quartz audit key held by five randomly drawn peers, who forfeit their own 10,000 POA stake if they approve a fake. Faking 200 agents costs 400,000 POA burned plus 200 Jade tickets, while one honest agent pays only its single 2,000 POA burn.
